speech: I found five things. Two lights answer to Living Room Light, the hall motion sensor battery is at 6%, and the kitchen plug dropped off Wi-Fi 9 times today. There are two smaller ones on screen.

findings.title: Two lights answer to Living Room Light
findings.detail: A Hue group and a Zigbee bulb are both called Living Room Light, so a command can reach the wrong one.

findings.title: Hall motion sensor battery at 6%
findings.detail: At 6% it may stop reporting motion soon.

findings.title: Kitchen plug dropped off Wi-Fi 9 times today
findings.detail: Its Wi-Fi signal is weak, at -82 dBm. Moving the plug or the router closer usually helps.

findings.title: An old copy of Hallway Lamp is still listed
findings.detail: It has been offline since October 3 and can catch commands meant for the real lamp.

findings.title: Fourteen devices turn on after a power cut
findings.detail: They are set to switch on whenever power comes back, even if they were off.
